comment: Blender8.cpp:103 replaces a negative blend value with its absolute value, so a MIX knob turned left with the CV jack patched gives the same blend as the mirrored position turned right; the clamp at :104-105 is unreachable because the value has already been made positive. The README calls the knob the CV attenuverter, which the sign folding contradicts. The IN1, IN2 and OUT jacks carry whatever is patched, so they get no family.
